messages:
oliver.product: Quick thread  tradeoffs for audit-first roadmap. Customer asks piling up: per-tenant audit exports, BYOK for evidence, and retention guarantees. Need scoping for next quarter.

zara.eng: For BYOK, Hosted supports envelope encryption with our KMS only. Full customer HSM requires Dedicated/Private. We can support export signing and manifest generation on Hosted.

mike.security: Require signed manifests + sha256 per chunk and an audit header with operator ID. For BYOK we need a handshake: customer public key -> server wraps export key -> signature proof. I'll draft handshake steps.

sophia.legal: Legal wants retention tiers defined in contract (30/365/7000), plus a legal-hold override API and audit trail. Also need explicit consent for cross-border export.

deep.sales: Enterprises want a SLA for "audit-ready export" (packaged for auditors). Also ask for a rush lane we can upsell. Need clear pricing bands.

nova.sre: Ops notes: large exports need chunked/resumable streaming, ephemeral cache (14 days) and an archival delivery option. Suggest capacity caps per-tenant for expedited lane. Also require dashboard for export backlog and failure alerts.

ci-bot: CI:export-service tests passed (large-chunking, resume)  https://ci.redwood.ai/exp/1201

oliver.product: Proposed MVP scope: formats=jsonl,parquet; modes=standard(48h)/expedited(6h up to 100GB); manifests+sha256; hosted=KMS-envelope; phase2=BYOK-HSM for Dedicated; legal-hold API; 14d ephemeral cache; cross-region consent UI. Agree?

zara.eng: Agree with MVP. Caveat: expedited SLA for hosted is best-effort; enforce soft concurrency limits and queue fallback. Will include sample curl and resumable pattern in API doc.

mike.security: Add requirement: server cert fingerprint and NTP-synced timestamp in manifest. BYOK phase must include escrow & key rotation notes.

sophia.legal: OK. I'll add contract snippets for retention change notice (30 days) and legal-hold audit fields. Also require customer attestations for cross-border transfers.

deep.sales: Request a one-pager + example contract excerpt for sales demos. Also sample pricing for rush lane.

nova.sre: I'll draft runbook, SLOs (99.5% success monthly), dashboard wires, and alert thresholds.

oliver.product: Owners & deadlines: zara API spec by 2026-05-02; mike security spec by 2026-04-28; sophia contract snippets by 2026-04-30; nova runbook by 2026-05-05; sales one-pager by 2026-05-08. Scheduling workshop with Sales+Support on 2026-04-15 11:00 PT.

zara.eng: adding incremental-export (deltas) to roadmap but not MVP.

mike.security: noted. Also include threat model doc for chain-of-custody.

oliver.product: Great. If no blockers, I'll update the roadmap card and open PRs for API+security specs. Drop edge cases here.

nova.sre: edge case: tenant-level legal-hold spanning cross-region archives  needs explicit release flow and manual escalation path.

sophia.legal: add eDiscovery assist clause for paid manual support.

deep.sales: :thumbsup: ready to brief customers after workshop.
